news.title: Most Americans Favor the Death Penalty for Those Convicted of Murder
news.summary_en: While 68% see the death penalty as morally justified for those committing murder, 59% say it doesn’t deter serious crimes – and there are wide partisan gaps on both questions.

news.title: Trump’s job approval rating is low by historical standards
news.summary_en: Trump’s job approval sits at 34%, lower than most recent presidents at comparable points, with a partisan gap of 78 percntage points.

news.title: Most U.S. senators appointed since 1990 have run to keep their seat – and most have won
news.summary_en: The U.S. Senate has had 43 appointed members since 1990, and 27 of them (63%) have run to keep their seat.

news.title: How confident are Americans in the midterm elections’ fairness and accuracy?
news.summary_en: Just over half of Americans are confident the 2026 midterms will be fair.

news.title: What do Americans think about language learning in U.S. schools?
news.summary_en: Four-in-ten Americans say it is extremely or very important for children growing up in the U.S. to learn a language other than English.
